title: Bombardment of Algiers (1683)
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Bombardment of Algiers (1683)", at revision 1370604967, opens: "The bombardment of Algiers in 1683 was a French naval operation against the Regency of Algiers during the Franco–Algerian war (1681–1688). It led to the rescue of more than 100 French prisoners, in some cases after decades of captivity, but the great majority of Christian captives in Algiers were not liberated." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q16010253, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1683 bombardment". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
